stories.headline: Harbor: more shots
stories.explanation: Harbor took 4 shots in the last 12 min 30 sec, up from 1 in the previous 12 min 30 sec.
stories.whatChanged: Harbor took 4 shots in the last 12 min 30 sec, up from 1 in the previous 12 min 30 sec.
stories.whyItMatters: Harbor's recorded shot activity has increased. This identifies more attempts; shot danger requires separate evidence. The extra attempts have not produced a recorded goal in this window. 1 recent shots followed attacking-third recoveries in the same possession within 30 recorded seconds: a route to watch, without establishing pressing or causation. Activity slowed in the latest half of the current window, so the increase may be fading.
stories.watchNext: Harbor: record at least 4 shots in the next equal 12m 30s window to sustain the measured count.

hypothesis.description: Harbor's recorded shots increased in the measured equal windows.

supportingEvidence.description: Harbor took 4 shots in the last 12 min 30 sec, up from 1 in the previous 12 min 30 sec.
The extra attempts have not produced a recorded goal in this window.

1 of the 4 recent shots followed recorded attacking-third recoveries in the same possession within 30 recorded seconds. This identifies a recorded attacking route, without proving pressing or causation.

limitingEvidence.description: Recorded events do not establish off-ball positioning, pressing intensity, intent or physical attacking direction.

contradictoryEvidence.description: The current-window increase is not sustained at the same rate in its latest half: 1 shots, after 3 in the first half. This limits an inference that the increase is continuing.
